query:
SELECT 
  poi.productId,
  p.name as productName,
  p.avgCost as avgCostBefore,
  poi.quantity,
  poi.unitCost
FROM purchaseOrderItems poi
LEFT JOIN products p ON poi.productId = p.id
WHERE poi.purchaseOrderId = 2490001
ORDER BY poi.id
